result: A batch Word or PDF read (the native_only job queueBatchDocumentTx makes) that ends DOCUMENT_INPUT_STALE is queued once more under current pins, at most twice per source, and its item shows its reading words until the new job settles.

movedPin.computed: document-context.ts:141 fingerprint({frame, context, siteId}) of the case; compared in assertDocumentInputTx document-context.ts:190-192 through compareSourcePins (source-pin.ts:9-14).
movedPin.write: The batch's first placed map part binds the unbound batch case to its area's site: source-building-import.ts:171 sourcePartDestinationTx -> areas.ts:427 bindRetainedCaseTx (UPDATE cases SET site_id). areas.ts:918 does the same when a part is saved into an area.
movedPin.notMoved: caseRevision may only move forward and is allowed (compareSourcePins); access, reader and policy pins are process settings; the source stayed the latest revision with its bytes (run 5 kept its SHA-256).
movedPin.concernsThisSource: No. The site a map layer binds says nothing about the Word document's bytes or reading; the pin is kept as it is (not loosened here).
movedPin.proof: Most likely, not proven on a runtime: in run 5 the small GeoTIFF was retained at 0.42 s and on the map at 9.06 s, the Word read ran 1.8-2.8 s with its attempt fenced, and no other case pin moves during a batch. The gated PostgreSQL test reproduces it with the real bindRetainedCaseTx write.

change: document-worker.ts failDocumentJob: on a stale end, after the job is marked stale and its words and event are written, requeueStaleDocumentTx runs in SAVEPOINT document_requeue; a refusal or any error rolls back to it, so the stale end and its words stay recorded.

documents.ts requeueBatchDocumentTx: refuses an OCR or archive selection, a propose job, a job named by an officer's source-document operation (retain or retry), a stale job that is not the source's latest, any queued or running job of the source, or a source with 3 document jobs (first + two re-queues); then locateDocumentInputTx (same subject, access, source revision, family, SHA-256, bytes, object key) and the existing enqueue (latest revision, job history limit, current pins).

intake-draft.ts rereadBatchPdfTx: writes the item's queued reading words again (a PDF above the page reader's bound keeps its unread-layer words); no item or a reviewed plan refuses, which rolls the new job back.
decisions: The count is not carried on the payload: a DocumentInput field is compared by compareSourcePins and fingerprinted at acceptance, so it would make every re-queued job stale unless document-context.ts changed (not owned). The bound comes from the source's job history instead (LIMIT 3), which an officer job can only shorten.
An officer request is recognised by an operations row of kind source-document whose result names the job (retain and retry both write one).
